physical_subject: Why does three cycles make three petals, but four makes eight?
relationship: For integer n, p(theta+pi)=(-1)^(n+1)p(theta), so odd n retraces while even n adds opposite petals.
operation: Trace r=R cos(n theta), compare half turns and show the sign and direction reversals for odd and even n.
substantive_difference: Polar radius sign and half-turn parity determine petal duplication, not harmonic acceleration or multiplicative radial growth.
